requirementText: 前后台切换、来电和系统重建后恢复最近页面与实际任务状态；不因重开页面重复创建下载或错误宣称游戏仍在运行。
assessmentKind: source audit; runtime acceptance not performed

rules.text: 保存根标签、路由、游戏选择、滚动锚点和已提交查询；重建后先读取本地事实再渲染。
rules.demands: Restore navigation and the submitted query with its corresponding facts; publish restored content only after local reconciliation.

evidence.supports: Root tab, route, stack, selection, query and modal identifiers use rememberSaveable.
The only restore effect reloads detail/game-update; it does not replay a search.
Content has no initialization-complete gate; SaveableStateProvider wraps pages.
Search displays the shared catalogue directly rather than filtering it by the displayed query.
DAO streams start independently; a new ViewModel initializes then calls default unfiltered refresh.
Only supplied query/genre go into requests; unfiltered refresh replaces catalogue.
ScrollPage delegates to rememberScrollState inside the saveable page holder.

pathsWalked.chain: MainActivity.onCreate -> HallViewModel.init -> initialize -> refresh() -> catalog; HallApp.restore(query,route=search) -> shared catalog rendering

pathsWalked.result: runs independently of initialize; no reconciled-snapshot publication gate

openQuestions: Native OS process-state restoration and scroll-anchor behavior with insertion/reordering are not executed; no claim that all scrolling restoration is absent.

rules.text: 任务和安装状态来自持久记录及文件对账，不能仅恢复上一次屏幕上的百分比。
rules.demands: Reconcile persisted transfers and active installations against local files before exposing their phase/bytes/readiness, including paused/offline work; recovery must not race a current operation.

evidence.supports: Transfer bytes/state, installation and sessions are durable Room entities.
Running worker verifies existing chunks and syncs new bytes before committing byte progress.
Recovery scans only journal files; early phases cause staging deletion.
initialize uses initializationLock, directly calls recovery and never reconciles every transfer/active installation.
Worker enters without initialize; paused, failed and completed transfers are not candidates.
Restored phase and progress come directly from persisted row.
Worker holds operationLock for install, but recovery does not acquire it.
An active extraction keeps journal CREATED until all files were processed; counts survive deletion of previously extracted files.

pathsWalked.result: durable records implemented, but paused/offline files not reconciled

pathsWalked.chain: initialize -> Installation.recover -> journal loop -> activate / delete staging
pathsWalked.result: journal crash recovery exists; no-journal active installs are not checked

pathsWalked.chain: TransferWorker.doWork -> perform -> operationLock -> Installation.install, concurrently with MainActivity -> initialize -> recover
pathsWalked.result: unlocked recovery can delete active staging

openQuestions: Scheduling/interleaving and physical interruption behavior require the later consolidated tests; the source race and skipped reconciliation paths are directly visible.

rules.text: 运行会话只有活进程及有效会话握手才能标记运行中；失联会话转恢复状态。
rules.demands: After a hall-process restart, confirm the recorded runtime identity through the real live process/Binder; reattach it or preserve recovery restrictions until death is established.

evidence.supports: Normal launch binds the runtime service and watches its Binder death.
Prepared handshake checks session/generation/nonce/PID; runtime phases accept matching, monotone identity-bound events.
Startup unconditionally marks every unfinished session crashed without checking live runtime identity, then schedules downloads.
Controller identity, nonce, PID and connection are only in memory.
attach updates an Activity reference; it does not recover a runtime connection.
Send failures are swallowed, host death has no runtime handling, and existing context rejects PREPARE instead of allowing reattachment.
Runtime resource blocker depends on unfinished DB rows.
Resource deletion and cache deletion rely on unfinished rows rather than actual process liveness.
Recovery notice comes from in-memory controller message; persisted crashed error is not restored into it.

runtime Binder death -> finish(crashed) -> persisted terminal state + in-memory message
main process reclaimed while :game survives -> new Application/controller -> initialize -> blanket crashed -> downloads/destructive-operation guards
pathsWalked.result: fails to reconcile live runtime and releases its restrictions

pathsWalked.chain: post-restart launch -> new validating record -> existing GameProcessService.PREPARE
pathsWalked.result: old singleton rejects PREPARE; no fresh handshake and no automatic proof of a second native runtime

Heartbeat expiry only changes controller message at SessionController.kt:110-116; whether that fulfills recoverable timeout UI is left for independent specification review and is not a separate finding.

rules.text: 旋转、来电、锁屏及再次点击图标都不能重复建立下载或第二个游戏会话。
rules.demands: Lifecycle and entrypoint replay must not enqueue content or invoke native start again; user commands must pass shared coordination.

evidence.supports: One repository and controller are Application-owned.
Initialization/refresh and click launch are distinct; actions serialized.
onResume only reattaches.
Shared operationLock and durable active-transfer check prevent another unfinished transfer for same game.
Unique WorkManager content-transfer scheduling uses KEEP.
launching/finishing/current-session guards prevent duplicate launch in same host process.
Launch preflight checks no unfinished session under shared lock before record creation.
:game runtime Activity uses singleTask and handles common configuration changes.
A consumed or unauthenticated onCreate is rejected before native loading.
Native module refuses a repeated start using atomic_exchange.
Calls/lockscreen pause/resume routes use commands, not launch/enqueue.

pathsWalked.result: F03 is recovery/liveness failure; native duplicate is blocked by existing-context and native-start guards

findings.title: A restored search replays an unfiltered catalogue request
findings.trigger: Submit a nonempty search, let the system save the task and reclaim the hall process, then restore its search page with connectivity.
findings.callChain: restored HallApp query/route -> new HallViewModel.init -> initialize -> refresh() with empty default arguments -> catalog overwrite -> search page renders catalog unchanged
findings.consequence: The search field shows the old query while results belong to the unfiltered catalogue; an unsubmitted draft also cannot be distinguished from the committed search.
findings.correction: Persist submitted search context separately from draft text and restore/refresh its exact catalogue snapshot after initialization.
findings.validationNeed: Process recreation of route=search with nonempty query and a changed draft; assert the matching query/filter request and result IDs.

findings.title: Restored bytes and installed state can bypass file reconciliation
findings.trigger: Restore a paused/failed/offline transfer whose partial archive is missing or truncated, or an active installation whose ready/package files are missing after its journal was cleaned.
findings.callChain: HallViewModel DAO streams -> HallApp content -> TransferCard/installed cards; initialize -> journal-only recover; paused work skipped by TransferWorker.doWork
findings.consequence: A nonexistent/truncated partial file keeps its old displayed byte progress; an installation with no files may still display installed/continue. No complete initialization gate prevents provisional facts being rendered.
findings.correction: Add bounded startup reconciliation for every persisted transfer and active installation, then publish a ready UI snapshot; downgrade missing files to recoverable task/repair state while preserving pause intent.
findings.validationNeed: Offline/paused task with absent and truncated files; no-journal active install with absent ready marker/critical files; assert truthful state before first content snapshot.

findings.title: Hall reconstruction releases a possibly live game's session
findings.trigger: Only the hall/main process is reclaimed while the ordinary separate :game process and GameActivity remain alive, then the hall is reopened.
findings.callChain: new Application/controller -> initialize -> every unfinished row set crashed -> downloads scheduled and DB-only resource/save guards see idle; next launch PREPARE ignored by existing GameProcess.context
findings.consequence: A live runtime loses its authoritative session/pin and resource-policy blockers; downloads or same-game resource/save operations can proceed while it is alive. Reopening it cannot reattach, and a retry may remain in preparation because PREPARE is ignored.
findings.correction: Restore a recovering/pinned record, probe and authenticate the existing process without creating a new runtime, reattach only on valid session/generation handshake, and release restrictions only after confirmed termination.
findings.validationNeed: Main-process-only kill with surviving runtime; assert no loss of pin/blocker, no destructive operations, successful reattach or explicit controlled termination; separately test dead runtime and late events.
findings.notClaimed: The source does not establish two simultaneous native games: PREPARE and native-start guards prevent that. The finding is loss of liveness reconciliation and safe recovery.

findings.title: Opening the hall can delete an installation still being extracted by its worker
findings.trigger: After process recovery, WorkManager starts before any Activity. During its active extraction, the user opens the hall for the first time in that process.
findings.callChain: TransferWorker.doWork(no initialize) -> perform -> operationLock -> install writes CREATED journal; concurrently HallViewModel.init -> initialize(initializationLock only) -> recover -> CREATED journal branch deletes staging and journal
findings.consequence: The active install can fail, or previously verified files can disappear while in-memory byte/seen totals remain valid, allowing an incomplete directory to be marked ready and activated.
interleaving: Worker extracts and hashes file A; total and seen include A while journal remains CREATED.
Startup recover reads CREATED, deletes the staging tree containing A and removes the journal without operationLock.
Worker creates parent directories for file B and continues. It does not recheck A at completion; aggregate counts still include A.
Worker writes ready/index, publishes the directory and activates it with A missing.
findings.correction: Make recovery and worker entry share one initialization barrier and operation lock/ownership check; never treat a journal owned by an active worker as abandoned.
findings.validationNeed: A deterministic two-file extraction barrier: pause after A validation, enter initialize/recover, resume B, and assert no active staging deletion or ready state with missing files.
